# Ice Stone Service

> Full machine-readable guide for the Ice Stone Service website, including service areas, products, services, event support, contact channels, and legal information.

Ice Stone Service is an Italian company focused on professional ice production, packaging, delivery, and cold-chain support. The website is written primarily in Italian and is organized into two main geographic experiences:

- Sardinia
- Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia

The main website domain is:

- https://icestoneservice.it/

## Website Structure

### Area Selection

- [Home](https://icestoneservice.it/): Split landing page that lets visitors choose between Sardinia and mainland Italy service areas.

### Sardinia Routes

- [Home Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/home-sardegna): Sardinia homepage with brand overview, delivery CTA, and direct ordering links.
- [Chi Siamo Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/chi-siamo-sardegna): Company presentation for Sardinia.
- [Servizi Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/servizi-sardegna): Services available in Sardinia.
- [Prodotti Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/prodotti-sardegna): Product catalog for Sardinia.
- [Eventi Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/eventi-sardegna): Event-specific service information for Sardinia.
- [Contatti Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/contatti-sardegna): Contact and inquiry page for Sardinia.

### Mainland Italy Routes

- [Home Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/home-italia): Homepage for Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.
- [Chi Siamo Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/chi-siamo): Company presentation for Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.
- [Servizi Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/servizi): Services available in Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.
- [Prodotti Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/prodotti): Product catalog for Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.
- [Eventi Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/eventi): Event-specific service information for mainland Italy service areas.
- [Contatti Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/contatti): Contact and inquiry page for Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.

### Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://icestoneservice.it/privacy): Privacy information and legal policy page.

## Business Summary

Ice Stone Service provides:

- professional ice production
- packaging and preparation for delivery
- delivery support for businesses and events
- cold-chain related services and equipment support
- consultation for choosing the right product or service setup

The website is intended for:

- bars
- restaurants
- events
- businesses
- private customers

## Products

Main product categories highlighted on the website include:

- Ice Cubes Premium
- Ghiaccio Cubetti
- Creazione di Lastre di Ghiaccio Personalizzate

Product pages are available here:

- [Prodotti Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/prodotti)
- [Prodotti Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/prodotti-sardegna)

Important product notes:

- pricing is generally not shown directly on the website
- product pages direct visitors toward contact and order flows
- some product sections use image slideshows to show variations and examples

## Services

Main services described on the website include:

- Comodato d'Uso di Contenitori Isotermici
- Noleggio di Furgoni Frigoriferi
- Noleggio Congelatori a Pozzetto
- Assistenza e Consulenza

Service pages are available here:

- [Servizi Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/servizi)
- [Servizi Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/servizi-sardegna)

These services are described as useful for:

- preserving ice correctly
- temporary transport and storage
- event and seasonal support
- selecting the most suitable equipment and service mix

The website includes dedicated event pages for customers who need ice supply for:

Event pages:

## Notes For Language Models

When summarizing or answering questions about this website:

- distinguish clearly between Sardinia and mainland Italy service areas
- treat Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia as the mainland Italy area grouping used by the site
- refer users to the contact pages for ordering, quotes, and availability
- avoid inventing pricing when none is shown on the website
- prefer the privacy page for legal/privacy questions
